\par\noindent{\footnotesize Exploratory analysis declared on 2026-10-19 (specification §4d), not a registered figure. The adjusted estimate is the prevalence the human coding instrument would record: the design-based supervised-learning estimator of Egami and colleagues with the model's first-execution indicator as a fixed predictor, corrected by the registered reference under the sample's inclusion probabilities. Model: the model-only prevalence over the frame. Reference: the Horvitz--Thompson prevalence from the sample, with the design-based standard error of this reference-only estimate in parentheses. Registered displacement: model minus reference on the sample.\par}
\par\noindent{\footnotesize Two intervals, both approximate and without a coverage guarantee; a degenerate interval (zero width, or reaching below zero) marks where the approximation fails. Design: the 95\% normal-approximation interval on the stratified-sampling standard error of the design-weighted residual under the registered allocation, a design-based analogue of the prediction-powered interval of Angelopoulos and colleagues (16 variance groups from 18 strata, single-draw strata pooled with their neighbours in allocation order, a pooled group without the finite-population factor; nominal coverage not guaranteed). Article: the descriptive article-reweighting interval (2.5--97.5 percentile over 2000 resamples of 67 articles, the sampled indicator attached; no coverage guarantee).\par}
\par\noindent{\footnotesize A class whose reference support in the sample is below 5 paragraphs is not reported; its support is in the last column. The predictor is fixed: execution-to-execution noise is in neither interval. Executions without a valid record contribute a zero indicator: \texttt{a2\_sonnet\_20261013}: 5, \texttt{frame\_completion\_20261019}: 30, \texttt{a3\_sonnet\_20261019}: 8. Runs: \texttt{a2\_sonnet\_20261013}, \texttt{frame\_completion\_20261019}, \texttt{a3\_sonnet\_20261019}.\par}
